meanings.usage: 指铺在地上的织物，这里幽默地指书堆成的地面
修饰动词，表示暂时的状态
指长时间地盯着看，常与at连用
表示所有权，强调个人拥有
in order表示整齐有序；out of order表示杂乱
长度单位，常用于测量较小距离
指房间的地面，floor space指地板空间
用于强调事实或真实情况

phrases.usage: 表示整齐有序，井井有条

examples.en: I have been trying to get my new room in order.
examples.zh: 我一直在努力整理我的新房间。

examples.en: Let's put these papers in order.
examples.zh: 让我们把这些文件整理整齐。

phrases.usage: 更糟糕的是，用来引出使情况更糟的因素

examples.en: To make matters worse, the room is rather small.
examples.zh: 更糟糕的是，房间相当小。

examples.en: It was raining, and to make matters worse, my car broke down.
examples.zh: 天在下雨，更糟糕的是，我的车坏了。

phrases.usage: 此刻；目前，与现在进行时连用

examples.en: At the moment, they cover every inch of floor space.
examples.zh: 此刻，它们覆盖了地板的每一寸空间。

examples.en: I'm very busy at the moment.
A short while ago, my sister helped me to carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs.
examples.zh: 刚才，我妹妹帮我把一个旧书架抬上楼梯。

examples.en: A short while ago, he was still a student.
I have to walk on them to get in or out of the room.
examples.zh: 我不得不踩着它们进出房间。

examples.en: You can sit here in your spare time and read the carpet!
examples.zh: 你可以在空闲时间坐在这里'读'地毯！

grammar.title: 现在完成进行时 (Present Perfect Continuous)
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + been + 动词-ing形式
grammar.definition: 表示动作从过去开始，一直持续到现在，可能还在进行或刚刚结束。常与all morning/all day/just等时间状语连用。 强调动作的持续性，常用时间状语有：all morning, all day, for + 时间段, since + 时间点

examples.en: I have been working hard all morning.
examples.zh: 我整个上午一直在努力工作。

examples.en: I have been trying to get my new room in order.
examples.zh: 我一直在努力整理我的新房间。

examples.en: She has been waiting for you for two hours.
examples.zh: 她已经等了你两个小时了。

grammar.title: to make matters worse
grammar.structure: to make matters worse, + 句子
grammar.definition: 插入语，用来引出使已经不好的情况更加糟糕的信息 用于引出更糟糕的情况，通常前面已经描述了一个不太好的情况

examples.en: To make matters worse, the room is rather small.
examples.zh: 更糟糕的是，房间相当小。

examples.en: It was cold, and to make matters worse, it started to rain.
examples.zh: 天气很冷，更糟糕的是，开始下雨了。

grammar.title: be made of 询问材质
grammar.structure: What is + 主语 + made of?
grammar.definition: 用 be made of 提问，of后接材料名词，用于询问某物是由什么制成的 询问物品的原材料或组成成分

examples.en: What is the writer's carpet made of?
examples.zh: 作家的'地毯'是什么做的？

examples.en: What is this table made of?
What is your jacket made of?
examples.zh: 你的夹克是什么材质的？

patterns.pattern: What is + 主语 + made of?

original.en: What is the writer's carpet made of?
original.zh: 作家的'地毯'是什么做的？

imitations.en: What is this dress made of?
imitations.zh: 这条裙子是什么材质的？

imitations.en: What is your new house made of?
imitations.zh: 你的新房子是什么结构的？

patterns.pattern: I have been + 动词-ing + 时间/all day/morning...

original.en: I have been working hard all morning.
original.zh: 我整个上午一直在努力工作。

imitations.en: I have been studying English all day.
She has been cooking since morning.
imitations.zh: 她从早上就开始做饭了。

patterns.pattern: to make matters worse, + 句子

original.en: To make matters worse, the room is rather small.
original.zh: 更糟糕的是，房间相当小。

imitations.en: To make matters worse, I lost my wallet.
imitations.zh: 更糟糕的是，我把钱包弄丢了。

imitations.en: To make matters worse, there was no taxi available.
imitations.zh: 更糟糕的是，没有出租车可用。

patterns.pattern: You can + 动词 + in your spare time

original.en: You can sit here in your spare time and read the carpet!
original.zh: 你可以在空闲时间坐在这里'读'地毯！

imitations.en: You can read books in your spare time.
imitations.zh: 你可以在空闲时间看书。

imitations.en: You can practice English in your spare time.
imitations.zh: 你可以在空闲时间练习英语。

lines.en: We have just moved into a new house and I have been working hard all morning.
lines.zh: 我们刚刚搬进一所新房子，我辛辛苦苦地干了整整一个上午。

lines.en: I have been trying to get my new room in order. This has not been easy because I own over a thousand books.
lines.zh: 我试图把我的新房间收拾整齐，但这并不容易，因为我有1,000多本书。

lines.en: To make matters worse, the room is rather small, so I have temporarily put my books on the floor.
lines.zh: 更糟糕的是房间还非常小，所以我暂时把书放在了地板上。

lines.en: At the moment, they cover every inch of floor space and I actually have to walk on them to get in or out of the room.
lines.zh: 这会儿，书把地板的每一点空隙都占据了，我实际上是踩着这些书进出房间的。

lines.en: A short while ago, my sister helped me to carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs.
lines.zh: 几分钟前，我妹妹帮我把一个旧书橱抬上了楼。

lines.en: She went into my room and got a big surprise when she saw all those books on the floor.
lines.zh: 她走进我的房间，当她看到地板上的那些书时，大吃一惊。

lines.en: 'This is the prettiest carpet I have ever seen,' she said.
lines.zh: “这是我见过的最漂亮的地毯，”她说。

lines.en: She gazed at it for some time then added , 'You don't need bookcases at all. You can sit here in your spare time and read the carpet!'
lines.zh: 她盯着“地毯”看了一会儿，又说：“你根本用不着书橱，空闲时你可以坐在这儿读地毯！”

questions.q: What is the writer's carpet made of?
questions.zh: 作家那块“地毯”是用什么做成的？
questions.a: It is made of books — the thousand-odd books he has temporarily put on the floor, which now cover every inch of floor space.
questions.aZh: 它是用书做成的——就是他暂时堆在地板上、铺满每一寸地面的那一千多本书。
questions.hint: 见第 3—4 句与第 7 句。

questions.q: Why has it not been easy to get the new room in order?
questions.zh: 为什么把新房间收拾整齐并不容易？
questions.a: Because he owns over a thousand books and, to make matters worse, the room is rather small, so the books have been temporarily put on the floor.
questions.aZh: 因为他有一千多本书，更糟糕的是房间还相当小。

questions.q: What did the writer's sister do a short while ago, and how did she react?
questions.zh: 几分钟前妹妹做了什么？她进屋后有何反应？
questions.a: She helped him carry one of his old bookcases up the stairs; going into his room, she got a big surprise when she saw all those books on the floor.
questions.aZh: 她帮他把一个旧书橱抬上了楼；走进房间看到满地是书，大吃一惊。

questions.q: Why does the writer say 'I have been working' rather than the present perfect?
questions.zh: 为什么用 I have been working 而不用现在完成时？
questions.a: The present perfect continuous stresses that the action has been going on all morning and is still unfinished, while 'have moved' simply states a completed result.
questions.aZh: 现在完成进行时强调动作持续了一上午且尚未结束。

questions.q: Why does the sister say 'You don't need bookcases at all'? Where does the humour lie?
questions.zh: 妹妹为什么说“你根本用不着书橱”？妙在哪里？
questions.a: Because the books already lie over the whole floor like a carpet; by praising the mess as the prettiest carpet she has ever seen, she turns his failure to tidy up into a compliment.
questions.aZh: 因为书已像地毯一样铺满地面；她把一片狼藉夸作“最漂亮的地毯”，把收拾失败的窘境变成了赞美。
questions.hint: 把第 7—8 句与第 2—4 句对照读。

translation:
我们刚刚搬进一所新房子，我辛辛苦苦地干了整整一个上午。
我试图把我的新房间收拾整齐，但这并不容易，因为我有1,000多本书。
更糟糕的是房间还非常小，所以我暂时把书放在了地板上。
这会儿，书把地板的每一点空隙都占据了，我实际上是踩着这些书进出房间的。
几分钟前，我妹妹帮我把一个旧书橱抬上了楼。
她走进我的房间，当她看到地板上的那些书时，大吃一惊。
“这是我见过的最漂亮的地毯，”她说。
她盯着“地毯”看了一会儿，又说：“你根本用不着书橱，空闲时你可以坐在这儿读地毯！”
title: A pretty carpet
subtitle: 漂亮的地毯

lead.question: 作家口中的“漂亮地毯”究竟是什么？为什么他还得踩着它进出房间？
lead.warmup: 刚搬进新家本是高兴事，可作家有一千多本书。他想把新房间收拾整齐，奋战一上午仍未完工；房间又小，书只能暂堆地板，铺得寸土不留，进出都得踩着走。妹妹上楼一瞧，竟把这一地书夸成“我见过的最漂亮的地毯”。
goals: 复述搬家整理房间的全过程，抓住“满地图书被夸成地毯”的幽默反转
掌握 temporarily、inch、space、actually、own、spare、gaze at 等核心词语
熟练运用 get/put ... in order、to make matters worse、at the moment、not ... at all 等结构
辨析现在完成时与现在完成进行时的差别，掌握最高级后接 ever + 现在完成时的用法
lead.summary: 课文以“刚搬进新房子、忙了一上午”开篇，点出整理房间之难：藏书千余册，房间又小，书只能暂放地板，铺满每一寸地面，作家进出都得踩着书走。几分钟前妹妹帮忙把旧书橱抬上楼，进门看见满地图书大吃一惊，却夸它是“我见过的最漂亮的地毯”，还劝他不必再买书橱。
lead.tips: I have been trying to get my new room in order 用现在完成进行时，强调持续整理、至今未完；若说 I have tried 只表示“试过”。

exercises.q: 语法填空：We ______ just ______ (move) into a new house and I ______ ______ ______ (work) hard all morning.
exercises.note: 搬入已完成，干活持续至今。

exercises.q: 汉译英（用 get ... in order）：我一直在设法把我的新房间收拾整齐。
exercises.a: I have been trying to get my new room in order.

exercises.q: 汉译英：更糟糕的是，房间还相当小，所以我暂时把书放在了地板上。
exercises.a: To make matters worse, the room is rather small, so I have temporarily put my books on the floor.

exercises.q: 选词填空（temporarily / inch / space / actually）：I have ______ put my books on the floor. They cover every ______ of floor ______ and I ______ have to walk on them.
用 It has been ... since 改写：My sister helped me carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs a short while ago.
exercises.a: It has been a short while since my sister helped me carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs.
exercises.note: since 从句用一般过去时。

exercises.q: 课文原句填空：You don't need bookcases ______ ______. You can sit here in your ______ ______ and read the ______!
汉译英：这是我见过的最漂亮的地毯。
exercises.a: This is the prettiest carpet I have ever seen.
exercises.note: 最高级 + ever + 现在完成时。

quiz.q: 作家口中的“漂亮地毯”实际上是什么？
options: A real Persian carpet
Over a thousand books lying on the floor
A large old bookcase
A new woollen blanket

quiz.q: 他为什么暂时把书放到地板上？
options: The room is rather small.
He has sold all his bookcases.
The floor is warmer than the shelves.
His sister asked him to do so.
quiz.note: to make matters worse, the room is rather small。

quiz.q: “I have been working hard all morning”强调什么？
options: An action that began this morning and has continued till now
A single action finished long ago
A habit formed in childhood
An action that will start tomorrow
quiz.note: 现在完成进行时强调持续。

quiz.q: 课文中表示“此刻、目前”的短语是哪一个？
options: A short while ago
All morning
At the moment
In one's spare time

quiz.q: “They cover every inch of floor space”中 inch 在句中的含义是什么？
options: Every bit of the floor, from one end to the other
A piece of furniture in the room
A kind of old book
A small corner near the door

quiz.q: 妹妹走进房间后说了哪句话？
options: “This is the prettiest carpet I have ever seen.”
“You have far too many bookcases.”
“Let me help you tidy the room.”
“The floor needs cleaning at once.”
